subject: Geopolitics
title: Soft Power and Narrative Control
description: A short lesson to help you apply Soft Power and Narrative Control.

hook.text: Korean dramas, Hollywood films, and Bollywood songs shape how the world sees nations. Culture is a weapon of attraction.

buildup.text: Soft power works through culture, education, and values. It makes others want what you want without coercion.

discovery.text: The US dominated soft power for decades through universities, tech, music, and film.

twist.text: China invests billions in Confucius Institutes and CGTN to spread its narrative.

climax.text: Whoever tells the most compelling story shapes global opinion.

punchline.text: Make the world admire you and you rarely need to threaten.

quiz.question: How does soft power differ from hard power?
options: Soft power uses military force indirectly
It attracts others through culture and values, not coercion
It only works between allied nations
